name: bizplug-theme-parks
description: The theme parks & attractions plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: ticket availability for a visit date. It works from the business's own published profile, covering hours, tickets, rides and visit planning, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Ticket availability for a visit date for theme parks & attractions businesses.

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.

test_cases.prompt: Ticket availability for a visit date
test_cases.expect: Calls check_ticket_availability and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: What are today's hours and ticket prices?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls request_tickets only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
